call_purpose: You came with a list of things to sort out, including your thank-you page, mobile landing page, email domain, invoices and course setup.

resolved.text: Your thank-you page redirect is set up, and your test order now goes to your own thank-you page.
The overlapping buttons on your mobile landing page are fixed, and you confirmed they look fine on your phone.

covered.text: Email domain: add your domain in Email settings, add the three DNS records you receive at your domain registrar, then click Verify.
EARLYBIRD coupon: if you decide to extend it, you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings.
Lesson drip: there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, and we are checking how it works for a course sold inside a bundle.
AI quiz generator: we are not aware of one being available right now and have no date for one, so please do not plan around it.

customer_next_steps.text: Have your developer add the three DNS records at your domain registrar.
Once the records are added, click Verify in your email settings.
Export your student list by going to Students, clicking Export and choosing CSV, which you mentioned you would try later.

support_next_steps.text: We will check with our billing team about changing the name on your invoices and get back to you.
We will check with our product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle and get back to you.

primary_topic: thank-you page, email domain and invoices
